action.objective: Commit Rc7+, the verified exact top move, driving the Black king and forcing it away from g7/a-pawn defense.
action.rationale: Rc7+ is the only commit_ready move: verified at effective depth 4, exact score 168, no immediate mate-in-one reply, no tactical refutation in the bounded probe. It gives check, forcing the Black king to move (PV: Kf7e6), and the rook attacks c-file and the seventh rank. Broad search also ranked Rc7 top among candidates at 213 (depth 3). The full board search at depth 4 included quiescence (captures, checks, check evasions) and found no refutation. Material is balanced (R+B+P vs R+B+P); the check keeps Black passive. No deeper comparison available; remaining verification reserve is sufficient and the move is safe within covered scope.
